n = int(input())
k = int(input())

mod = 1000000007

# Initialize matrices
def create_matrix():
    return [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]

# Initialize ans matrix
ans = create_matrix()
for i in range(k + 1):
    ans[i][i] = 1

# Initialize t matrices
t = [create_matrix() for _ in range(k)]
for p in range(k):
    for i in range(k + 1):
        for j in range(k + 1):
            t[p][i][j] = 1 if (i == j or i == p) else 0

# Matrix multiplication
def multi(m1, m2):
    result = create_matrix()
    for i in range(k + 1):
        for j in range(k + 1):
            s = 0
            for p in range(k + 1):
                s += m1[i][p] * m2[p][j]
            result[i][j] = s % mod
    return result

# Process the number n into bits
bit = []
temp_n = n
while temp_n > 0:
    bit.append(temp_n % k)
    temp_n //=k
bit.append(0)
bit.reverse()

# Partial sum of bits
for i in range(1, len(bit)):
    bit[i] += bit[i - 1]

# Work function
for p in range(len(bit) - 1):
    for i in range(bit[p] - 1, bit[p + 1] - 1, -1):
        ans = multi(t[i % k], ans)

pre = [create_matrix() for _ in range(k)]
suf = [create_matrix() for _ in range(k)]

# Initialize pre and suf
pre[0] = t[0]
for i in range(1, k):
    pre[i] = multi(pre[i - 1], t[i])

suf[k - 1] = t[k - 1]
for i in range(k - 2, -1, -1):
    suf[i] = multi(t[i], suf[i + 1])

# Update t with the computed matrices
t[0] = suf[0]
for i in range(1, k):
    t[i] = multi(suf[i], pre[i - 1])

# Calculate the sum
sum_value = 0
for i in range(k + 1):
    sum_value += ans[i][k]
print(sum_value % mod)
